text:
aya_infra: Heads up — planning to onboard a dense inference fleet in us-west-2 (cluster: inference-prod-west-2). Need help with account limits for pod IPs / ENI headroom before next week.
sam_eng: How many nodes and what instance type are you planning?
aya_infra: Starting with 8 p4d.24xlarge for throughput tests, target ~18 pods/node average. We want to enable prefix-delegation so we can pack pods, but VPC secondary IPv4 pool is too small.
ben_sre: On AWS we need two things: increase ENI (elastic network interfaces) quota and make sure the subnet has enough free IPs. Trunking + prefix delegation helps but you still need overall IP headroom.
liz_platform: Also confirm aws-vpc-cni config — prefix-delegation requires the right iam and addon settings. Do we plan custom networking (calico) or standard aws-cni?
aya_infra: Standard aws-vpc-cni w/ prefix-delegation. I can update the addon, but want quotas first so we don't hit pod IP exhaustion mid-rollout.
sam_eng: Also check kubelet max-pods per instance plan — with high pack density we should set kubelet --max-pods appropriately or use pod density profiles. That affects scheduling too.
aya_infra: Agreed. Drafting the AWS request now. Will include numbers and cost justification.
aya_infra: ```
Request to AWS Support:
- Region: us-west-2
- Quotas to increase:
  * Elastic Network Interfaces (EC2) +20
  * VPC IPv4 address pool for cluster subnet: increase from /20 to /18 (secondary range)
  * Service quota: EC2 ENI Trunking support review (enable prefix delegation)
Reason: inference-prod-west-2 will run 8 p4d nodes with high pod density (avg ~18 pods/node) for batched inference. Need IP headroom and ENI allowance to support prefix delegation.
Contact: aya_infra@redwood.com
```
quota-bot: Created AWS support case AWS-432789, status: open. ETA for review: 48-72h.
ben_sre: Good. Note: if AWS rejects ENI bump we can switch to larger subnet in the same VPC but that requires network change window.
liz_platform: I'll add fallback options to the rollout doc: (1) deploy in us-east-1 as backup, (2) use m5n.24xlarge pack with fewer pods/node, (3) increase node count instead of density.
ops-oncall: Please add tagging and termination protection steps to the runbook — cost center tag + lifecycle hooks for scaling.
sam_eng: Can you post the exact CIDR and current free IPs in the subnet? I can run a quick ip-availability check.
aya_infra: Current subnet: 10.200.64.0/20, free IPs ~3.2k. With /18 target we'd add ~16k addresses; need approval for that expansion.
ben_sre: Timeline? AWS quota approvals can take up to 72h. If we need go-live sooner, prefer fallback to us-east-1 or increase node count.
aya_infra: Target deploy: next Monday (6 days). If AWS doesn't approve by Friday EOD we'll fall back to us-east-1 for initial rollout.
liz_platform: I'll run cost comparison p4d x8 vs p4d x4 + more nodes and share numbers by tomorrow.
sam_eng: :thumbsup:
quota-bot: AWS-432789 updated: additional info requested — submitted requested eni-per-region clarifications.
aya_infra: Thanks team — I'll paste AWS case link and keep this thread updated when quota moves.
